lock_mode_before_rebase.meaning: existing 2-bit lockMode field value of the OraclePack before rebaseOraclePack executes

lock_mode_after_rebase.meaning: 2-bit lockMode field value of the OraclePack after rebaseOraclePack executes, reported as '00' (0)

rebase_executed.meaning: occurrence of the rebaseOraclePack function being executed

assumptions: The lockMode field is a 2-bit value; the report states the post-execution value is '00' (0).
The prior lockMode value is symbolic and not fixed by the report beyond the Guardian setting it to 3 in the described scenario.

unresolved.description: Report does not state the exact prior lockMode value for the general case; only the Guardian-set value 3 is mentioned, so lock_mode_before_rebase remains symbolic.

limitations: No frozen P sources were selected; the claim is conditioned only on rebaseOraclePack execution.
The correspondence is stated at the field-value level; code-level binding of the 2-bit mask is deferred.
The report's 'always 00' is treated as the asserted post-execution observable for this impact, not as a universal quantification over all executions.
